name: warcraft-lua-protector
description: Local protection and optimization tooling for Warcraft III Lua maps

scripts.check: eslint . && node --input-type=module -e "for (const name of ['seed', 'engine-names', 'zopfli', 'compress', 'mpq', 'lua-syntax', 'lua-names', 'lua', 'string-codec', 'strings', 'vm', 'natives', 'config', 'presets', 'map-info', 'cleanup', 'cleanup-review', 'savings', 'protect', 'output', 'publication', 'jobs', 'desktop', 'cli']) await import('./src/' + name + '.mjs');"
